name: extension-dev
description: Build, run, debug, test and ship Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Safari extensions from your AI agent, on the extension.dev platform with the Extension.js framework.
longDescription: extension.dev is the platform where browser extensions ship, and Extension.js is the open source framework they are built with. This plugin gives an agent the browser-extension skill (cross-browser manifest rules, the silent failures that cost the most time, debugging against a live browser, store listings and submissions) and the extension.dev MCP server (scaffold from a template, run the extension with hot reload, inspect the live DOM and logs, assert what it rendered, build per browser, publish a build and submit it to the Chrome Web Store, Edge Add-ons, Firefox Add-ons or the App Store). A store submission always waits for a human approval.
prompts: Create a Chrome extension that highlights every external link on the page, and prove it injects.
Build my extension for Chrome and Firefox from one codebase and tell me what the manifest needs.
Get my extension ready for the Chrome Web Store, Edge Add-ons, Firefox Add-ons and the App Store.
